Pick a map, barricade the windows, survive every wave.

DESKTOP

WASD move · Shift sprint · Space jump
Left click fire · R reload
E buy / interact (hold E at a barricade to rebuild)
V or F knife/sword · G hold to cook, release to throw a grenade
W/S climb ladders · Q / wheel / 1-3 swap weapon · X weapon mode · Esc/P pause
MOBILE (landscape works best)
Left side: touch & drag to move
Right side: drag to look (also while holding FIRE)
FIRE hold to shoot · RELOAD · BUY (hold at windows: REPAIR) · AIM (left side: tap to toggle, hold to aim)
KNIFE · GREN (hold to cook) · JUMP · SPRINT toggle · SWAP weapon · MODE (dual-mode weapons)
Start with 500 points and an M1911. Points: 10 per hit, 80 per kill, 100 per headshot kill, 130 per melee kill (doubled by Double Points). Open the train doors (750) to reach the Brakeman Pump 12 (1000), then use the driver's controls to Travel to Station 2 (1500) for the rifle, SMG, gold magnum and the Upgrade Machine (4000 / 9500 / 18500). The glowing soda machine sells Steel Bones, Stamina Madness and Extra Lives. Power-ups: Max Ammo, Insta Kill, Double Points, Round Wipe. Clear the Station 2 stairs (1750) to reach the ruined street: throw the power switch (perks + upgrades need power), climb to the roof for the Samurai Sword, grab the Dual SawedOffs, refill at the Ammo Box, or try your luck with the Coin Flip pedestrian.
Original game · all art procedurally generated · synthesized sound
